_comment: Map each stock ticker Grok trades to its Bitget tokenized-stock symbol. Set the value to null if a ticker has no Bitget equivalent yet -- the pipeline will skip it and alert you instead of silently failing. Verify exact Bitget symbol formatting (e.g. 'x' suffix) with `bgc discover` or the Bitget app before relying on this.

_cash_proxies._comment: Grok sometimes parks weight in T-bill ETFs (e.g. SGOV) as a cash-equivalent. Bitget doesn't tokenize these. Decide how you want to treat 'cash' weight -- e.g. hold as idle USDT in the sub-account rather than trying to buy an equivalent.
